changes: A pull request moves network's port to 9090 and adds a SQL Yodeler migration: a unique index on email in Postgres.
watch: Wave 1 changes network. SQL Yodeler finds two users with one email in wave 2 and applies nothing. The driver (this demo's script) removes one, and the re-run asks a person before the migration runs again.
shows: Work that landed stays in place. SQL Yodeler checks the rows first, and a second run completes the change.
